progression.narrative: The performance opens on Dk4 and dwells most on E in Zabol & Chaharmezrab Zabol. The line peaks at G4 (395.0 Hz) at 1:17.5. It closes on E3, not the tonic (E4 → G4 → Dk4 → E4 → E4 → E3).
